program.description: The folder name the host keeps the program under: lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, 1 to 64.

summary.description: What it is, in a sentence, for the page that opens it.

icon.description: The name of one of the application's glyphs ([`STORE_GLYPHS`]) that suggests the program; an application draws its default for none or a name it does not know.

commands.description: The commands the host's copy puts on the `PATH` of what the host starts: `node`, `npm` and `npx` for Node. What names one of them (an agent's or an MCP server's command) is a user of the program. None for a program that is on no `PATH`.

when.description: The provider settings that select the program, such as `{"harness": "grok"}`; empty selects any.

serves.description: The harness providers that start it.

platforms.description: The platforms it has been measured on. The engine refuses none: a platform not listed here is for the recipe's `release` to accept or refuse, as the publisher's own release does.

channels.description: Its release channels; the first is the default, and none means it has none.

endpoints.description: The `https` places it fetches from, and the only ones the host lets a download or a redirect reach: an origin (`https://host`), or a prefix with a path (`https://host/bucket/`) that a URL has to start with.

services.description: The `https` places the program itself reaches while it runs, beyond where it is fetched from (a package registry): the host asks the system's proxy about each, to choose the proxy a program is started with. They are not endpoints: a download is never let reach them.

lists.description: What the type lists, in the plural: `overlays`, `skills`.

format.description: The format every catalog of the type answers in: [`crate::store::catalog::MODELS_FORMAT`] or [`crate::store::catalog::RELEASES_FORMAT`]. None for a type whose catalogs are read in a format of the host's own.

label.description: What canoa.cfg calls it (`[store.<type>.catalogs.<label>]`): 1 to 64 letters, digits, `.`, `_` and `-`. An entry with this label replaces it whole.

fields.description: The values the provider's form holds, as a JSON object; absent for none.

pin.description: The revision the extension's author verified (a commit, a version), or `sha256:<hex>` of the catalog's text. A pinned catalog is read once and never refreshed by time; absent follows the provider's upstream.

snapshot.description: The catalog's text, in the type's format, as it was when `pin` was verified: what a pinned catalog answers with when it has not been fetched (a first run with no network). Absent ships none.

defaults.description: The catalogs the extension registers for the type, offered until the person replaces one by its label, adds another, or turns one off. The first is the type's default.

catalogs.description: What the program's store calls its catalogs and the ones its extension registers for it: where its releases are listed (`canoa.releases/1`). None for a store whose releases the recipe reads itself.

when.description: The provider settings that select the program, such as `{"harness": "grok"}`; empty selects any.

channel.description: The channel to install from when a request names none; absent is the store's default.

version.description: A version to pin every install and update to; absent is the newest.

managed.description: The host's own copy, when it has one.
